title: The Thesis Generator
intent: Produce high-density, structure-enforceable, η-aware theses that advance OpenRoot or related domains with minimal wasted motion.
eta_goal: Raise the quality and speed of original intellectual contribution.
core_framing: A thesis is a falsifiable claim backed by reasoning and, where possible, measurement.
High-η theses increase ordered understanding relative to the attention required to produce and read them.
Every thesis should be absorbable as a future seed.
optimized_query_patterns: Generate a tight thesis on [topic] that is falsifiable, η-aware, and immediately useful to the OpenRoot ledger.
What is the strongest counter-argument to this claim and how is it addressed?
constraints: No unfalsifiable assertions without labeling them as such
verification_notes: Peer or self-critique against falsifiability and η criteria.
next_physical_or_action: Write one short, absorbable thesis this week and run it through the structure enforcer.
